title: Business Entity Profile
description: A universal schema for representing commercial business entities (providers, clients, vendors) and their billing/banking details within AXIONYX.

entityId.description: Unique UUID for the business entity

role.description: The operational role of the business within AXIONYX

parentEntityId.description: If this is a subsidiary, links back to the Mother Company UUID

seedEntityId.description: If this is a Fruit, links back to the Originating Seed entity UUID

complianceStandards.description: Scientific or structural standards this entity adheres to (e.g., ['ROOT_SYSTEM', 'ISO_17025'])

isProtectedAsset.description: Indicates this company is treated as a protected asset within the network

paymentRouting.description: Forces all billing and payments to route upward to the Mother Company

shippingLogic.description: Decentralized operational logistics rules for the subsidiary

declaredAssets.description: Mandatory prior declaration of owned physical/digital assets

serviceMethod.description: The primary service provisioning method (used for Clients)
